_comment: F41 biome look candidate. One fixed-purple rig at every clock hour; the existing Surge presentation supplies phase, rain, flash and aftermath deltas. OFF until matched Medium/High three-judge Bar A >=8.5. No save, collision, scatter or creature-scale changes.

storm_grade._candidate: m50 chapter-wide storm light grade (OFF until judged). GPU SW13 and SW19 judges (15/15): the scene does not carry the storm. A camera-relative rim (shadowless directional light from beyond the subject toward the camera, rim_elevation_deg above) puts a lit edge on trunks, creatures and the trainer in every view, its colour and energy per phase and lifted by the surge flash at Break; a per-phase world grade sets environment brightness, contrast and saturation, eased between phases. Nothing new in the ground or sky. Presentation only; reduced motion drops the flash pulse.
storm_grade._why_rim_specular: m50 first CPU look: a grazing back light with specular put a white hot spot on the wet ground under the trainer; diffuse only.

storm_light._candidate: r26 storm light (OFF until judged). GPU F41 R verdict, path to 7.5 item 2: every stand is one dark mid-tone with no rim light. A cool, low, shadowless back light from the side opposite the sun puts a lit edge on trunks, creatures and the trainer, and a little more grade contrast separates the layers. Presentation only.

materials._comment: Installed base textures, alpha masks, authored tint and emission remain authoritative. Metre-based relief and restrained broad variation unify opaque world surfaces; emissive effects and actor materials are excluded.
